name: fixed-workflow-baseline
notes: IR-542's labelled baseline for the fixed-workflow pilot (IR-551). Synthetic records only: no CIT-U content, no proxy paper, no vendor call. `contract` is what IR-543/IR-546/IR-547 must eventually return; `baseline` is what main returns today through the authenticated Ask IRIS HTTP, SSE and conversation boundary, pinned by apps/ai/tests/test_fixed_workflow_baseline_http.py. The screening fake decides from the human labels below, so a baseline run measures the workflow's plumbing and coverage wording, never screening quality. Contract text: docs/evaluation/fixed-workflow-pilot/README.md.

snapshot.description: One reader with no role beyond student. Another user owns one draft. One published record is refused by the disclosure gate, standing in for an embargoed or unconsented paper.
